## Description

Combines fractional cointegration spread models with multivariate Hawkes point processes to detect bursty lead-lag price transmission and execute high-frequency statistical arbitrage.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency lead-lag trading between index futures and spot ETF baskets, fragmented crypto venues.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading Firms, Statistical Arbitrage Prop Desks.

## Required data

Synchronized sub-second quote and trade tick streams, fractional differencing parameters.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood estimation of Hawkes kernels requires high-performance C++/GPU acceleration.
